note: Background library for 'Your own adventure'. avatar_position: x, y = where the avatar's feet go (fractions of the picture); scale = avatar height as a fraction of the picture height. ending: suitable for the final goodnight page.

backgrounds.title: Sunrise meadow
backgrounds.description: Wide green meadow with soft rolling hills, a few round trees and a gentle sun rising over the hills.

backgrounds.title: Wildflower garden
backgrounds.description: Flower garden with tall pink and purple foxgloves, poppies and blue flowers, a rose arch on the right and a little winding path.

backgrounds.title: Golden forest trail
backgrounds.description: Sunny forest of golden and orange trees with a soft path through the middle, ferns and mossy rocks.

backgrounds.title: Moonlit woodland clearing
backgrounds.description: Quiet clearing in a blue night wood under a big full moon and twinkling stars, with little mushrooms at the edges.

backgrounds.title: Autumn woodland
backgrounds.description: Woodland of red and orange autumn trees with falling leaves and a leafy path.

backgrounds.title: Peaceful riverside
backgrounds.description: Slow winding river through green fields, with tall reeds and a weeping willow tree on the right.

backgrounds.title: Wooden bridge
backgrounds.description: Little arched wooden bridge over a blue stream, with leafy trees and flowers on both banks.

backgrounds.title: Lakeside at dawn
backgrounds.description: Still misty lake at dawn with pine trees on the far shore, pink sky reflected in the water and smooth pebbles on the near shore.

backgrounds.title: Hidden waterfall
backgrounds.description: Secret green glade with a small waterfall and a rainbow in its spray, a little pool, hanging vines, ferns and mossy rocks.

backgrounds.title: Sandy beach
backgrounds.description: Wide soft sandy beach with gentle waves, a pale sky and a few seashells in the sand.

backgrounds.title: Lighthouse cliff
backgrounds.description: Grassy clifftop by the sea with a red and white striped lighthouse glowing in the evening light.

backgrounds.title: Snowy winter valley
backgrounds.description: Quiet snowy valley with frosty pine trees, a frozen winding stream and soft falling snow.

backgrounds.title: Mountain viewpoint
backgrounds.description: Green hilltop looking out over rolling hills and misty blue mountains, with a curly tree on the right.

backgrounds.title: Storybook village
backgrounds.description: Cosy village of little cottages with thatched and tiled roofs, warm windows and a cobbled lane, with a wooden fence in front.

backgrounds.title: Castle courtyard
backgrounds.description: Friendly castle courtyard with pointed towers and little flags, an arched gate, a fountain and pots of flowers.

backgrounds.title: Cosy cottage
backgrounds.description: Warm cottage room with a crackling fireplace, a soft armchair with a knitted blanket, a teapot, shelves and a round rug.

backgrounds.title: Magical library
backgrounds.description: Round library with tall shelves full of books, a rolling ladder, a hanging lantern, a moonlit window and books floating in the air.

backgrounds.title: Starry observatory
backgrounds.description: Observatory with an open dome showing the starry sky and a crescent moon, a brass telescope, a globe and star maps on a desk.

backgrounds.title: Enchanted treehouse
backgrounds.description: Big leafy tree at dusk with a little wooden treehouse, a rope ladder and twinkling fairy lights in the branches.

backgrounds.title: Bedtime bedroom
backgrounds.description: Calm bedroom at night with a cosy bed and patchwork quilt, a bedside lamp, a window showing the moon and stars, a round rug and a small bookshelf.
